summary: The plan cleanly extracts the existing validator, preserves its compatibility contract and safety behavior, adds focused coverage for required valid and malformed inputs, and limits production scope to the autonomous-agent package.

findings.message: workflow.ts has four validator invocation locations: plan review, initial code review, governance review, and the independent code review after governance fixes. The plan refers to three call sites/gates; retain its stated no-bypass check but verify the post-governance code-review invocation as well.
